trajectory_summary: The call opens warm but stalls immediately because Doug, the person on the phone, cannot answer nearly any qualifying question — bill amount, credit score, scheduling — and the real contact is his wife. The rep never firmly redirects to book a specific time with the wife; the call ends in a vague 'I'll call later today' with no bill, no appointment, and no locked time. Energy leaked steadily from intro to close with no recovery.
outcome_dispute: v1 tag is unknown; observed outcome is a callback at best (rep will call the wife later), not a booked or tentative appointment — no day/time was agreed with the actual decision-maker.
